name: Bernard of Świdnica
note: co-ruler with his brother Henry I; duchy divided into Świdnica and Jawor (1312-1346); Bernard in Świdnica

name: Henry I of Jawor
note: co-ruler; in Jawor (and Głogów from 1337); died without male heirs, Jawor reincorporated in Świdnica

name: Bolko II the Small
note: in Świdnica, jointly with his brother Henry II until 1345; reunited Świdnica-Jawor 1346

name: Agnes of Austria
note: widow of Bolko II, succeeded by his will; after her death the duchy was annexed to the Kingdom of Bohemia
